actual_return_scope.meaning: The stable return target was paid earlier. The flag does not identify only the latest paid site.

unrestricted_projections.proof: Every row has an independent private slack. Fix a whole legal holder or the entire old 55-name relation, choose all other non-slack values, then complete each unconstrained row at its private slack. Any illegal pinned row remains illegal. Canonical parity and NAE each allow every proper projection by filling a forgotten name.
